                    demand_v = demands[v]
                    a = depot if pos == 0 else ri[pos - 1]
                    b = depot if pos == len(ri) - 1 else ri[pos + 1]
                    # removal cost from route i
                    cost_remove_i = matrix[a][b] - (matrix[a][v] + matrix[v][b])

                    for j in range(len(routes)):
                        if j == i:
                            continue
                        if loads[j] + demand_v > capacity:
                            continue
                        rj = routes[j]
                        lj = loads[j]
                        # insertion positions
                        for k in range(len(rj) + 1):
                            prev = depot if k == 0 else rj[k - 1]
                            nxt = depot if k == len(rj) else rj[k]
                            cost_insert_j = (matrix[prev][v] + matrix[v][nxt]) - matrix[prev][nxt]
                            net_delta = cost_remove_i + cost_insert_j
                            if net_delta < 0:
                                routes[i] = ri[:pos] + ri[pos + 1 :]
                                routes[j] = rj[:k] + [v] + rj[k:]
                                move_done = True
                                break
                        if move_done:
                            break
                    if move_done:
                        break
                if move_done:
                    break
            if not move_done:
                break

    def cleanup_empty(routes):
        out = []
        for r in routes:
            if r:
                out.append(r)
        return out

    routes = build_initial()

    two_opt_intra(routes)
    routes = cleanup_empty(routes)
    relocate_inter(routes)
    routes = cleanup_empty(routes)
    return routes
